answer: Each identity anchors to one registered glacier ice-core drill site: a $2,000 rig whose ivory core barrel cuts a fresh core each epoch, signing depth, temperature, dust-layer readings bound to the epoch nonce, checked by satellite glacier-flow data and a violet-filter core photo. One site, one vote; two identities sharing a rig report the same core and collapse to one vote, burning a $50 stake. A farm wanting 100 votes must buy and staff 100 rigs on 100 glaciers, $2,000 each plus $90 a year in fuel, each needing one logged season. No fresh signed core, no vote; cost rises linearly with n.
